# Verify HTML Fixture

*A report built to exercise verify_html: sections, links, a dashes row, citations, and a bibliography note.*

## Executive Summary

The renderer must keep every authored word on every path, including this one [1].

## Body

The [protocol page](https://example.com/protocol) keeps its URL as a live anchor in the body, a [draft note](../drafts/note.md) renders as plain text with its target in brackets, and `[t](https://e/code)` stays a literal code span.

### Sources of support

Support came from two fellowships and no vendor [2].

### Data

| Case | Marker | Note |
|---|---|---|
| alpha | a | normal row |
| dashes | x | --- |
| omega | z | normal row |

#### Reading the table

Every data row above must survive the render, dashes included.

## Limitations

Small on purpose.
